binding_rule: Repository functions that decide whether a constitutional change may proceed require an individually authored direct FunctionContract rather than only a generated path template.

contracts.authority_requirement: The guard cannot approve a constitutional change. With no external/trusted-base approval verifier implemented, any constitutional-path change must return ESCALATE.
contracts.result_algebra: PASS only when no declared constitutional path changed; otherwise ESCALATE with explicit touched paths and no approval authority.
contracts.resource_and_termination_bounds: Finite set intersection over observed changed paths.
